pdf: How these figures are worked out
• Consumption: warp g/m = ends × denier / 9000 × (1 + warp shortage); weft g/m = PPI × reed space × pick share × denier /
9000 × (1 + weft shortage). Shortage here: warp 2%, weft 2%.
• A TPM yarn costs its base yarn rate plus its delta; a temporary base rate or delta, where typed, is used in their place.
• Realisation per pick = (sale rate − RFD cost) / picks per sale metre (PPI × greige m per RFD m); with VATAV, the VATAV amount
is also taken off. RFD cost = RM cost × greige m per RFD m + processing × greige m per RFD m + transportation + brokering % ×
• Loom metres per day = RPM × 1440 × loom efficiency / (PPI × 39.37) × panna. Looms narrower than 250 cm use the fabric's
single panna RPM; 280 cm looms use its double panna RPM (the 280 cm RPM), single or double panna, and single panna is not
doubled. Loom efficiency is the unit's. Double panna where two reed spaces fit the loom's reed width (/ 2.54, + 0.5″).
• Loom realisation = realisation per pick with VATAV × metres per loom per day × PPI. Profit per pick = realisation per pick with
VATAV − the unit's cost per pick.
• TFO kg per spindle per day = TFO RPM / TPM × 1440 × TFO efficiency × denier / 9,000,000; the RPM is stored already × 2. kg
per side = per spindle × spindles per side (252). Spindles per loom = TPM kg a loom uses per day / kg per spindle per day. Spindle
profitability = profit per pick / spindles a single panna loom needs on the old TFO machines.
• Figures use the latest yarn rates.
